sources.title: HKCOLO: Operational Resilience - Successful Cooling Tower Contingency Drill, 28 September 2026
sources.summary: The operator reports that its September contingency exercise at the named Telehouse CCC Data Center activated the standby cooling tower while maintaining normal temperatures and stable data-centre operations. After inspection and maintenance, the cooling system returned to normal operation. The original page also carries later October event reports and a 3 November company-representation statement; these do not report a later physical-status change.
sources.date_semantics: 28 September is the dated operator report; it describes a drill in September without stating its exact day. Existing operation as reported then, not a new opening, and not renewed to the November capture date.

sources.title: HKCOLO Cloud Computing Complex: numbered address and facility specifications
sources.summary: The original CCC facility table identifies 2 Chun Yat Street, Tseung Kwan O, New Territories, Hong Kong. It describes a three-storey data-centre building with rooftop, colocation cabinets, cages and suites, and staffed operations. The page is undated and supplies identity and specifications only.

sources.title: Telehouse Hong Kong CCC brochure, made April 2026
sources.summary: The original brochure identifies HKCOLO.NET Limited as operator of Telehouse Hong Kong CCC. Page 11 describes three data-hall floors, 33,829 square metres gross floor area, 40 MVA power capacity, N+1/2N UPS and transformer/generator configurations, and N+1 water cooling and CRAC design. These are published design specifications, not measured demand, completed new capacity or guaranteed performance. Page 16 states the material was made in April 2026; the publication day is unstated.
sources.date_semantics: The PDF says made in Apr 2026; no precise publication day is invented. Brochure identity and design specifications only, not current status evidence.
sources.visual_review: Original PDF pages 2, 11 and 16 rendered locally and visually reviewed for operator identity, aligned specification labels/values and April 2026 production date.

sources.title: Stadt Frankfurt building-address object DEHEFALK1Bt0000L: Wilhelm-Fay-Straße 23
sources.summary: The municipal address index returns exactly one building-address object, DEHEFALK1Bt0000L, labelled Wilhelm-Fay-Straße 23. Its EPSG:25832 point [470098.4330000002,5552789.347999999] transforms to WGS84 [8.581671104900451,50.12658873938657], rounded to [8.5816711,50.1265887]. The city configuration supplies the CRS. This is an address anchor for the existing MK FRA2 campus, not a building footprint or accuracy guarantee.

sources.title: MK Netzdienste original FRA2 facility identity page
sources.summary: The operator identifies its Frankfurt data centre as FRA2. Its footer at Dresdener Straße 18, Minden is a company contact address, not the Frankfurt facility. The exact Frankfurt address is established by the tenant’s named-host report. Undated specifications and historical building works are not used to renew status.
